observations: Every original randomized-trial participant in preserved source order with stable P0001-P0235 IDs; no simulated participants or outcomes

endpoint.missing: exclude from both fits; no imputation
endpoint.clinical_scope: absence of postoperative sore throat at 30 minutes, not camrelizumab efficacy or partial remission

common_cohort.exclusion_reason_policy: comma-separated missing_<column_name> tokens in required-column order; empty for included rows

fit.standard_error: inverse observed Fisher information; no sandwich estimator
fit.predictor_policy: Never include recorded gender or randomized arm as a model term; no interactions, centering, scaling or other covariates

artifacts.cohort.tsv: One row per source participant: included, binary response or NA, exclusion reason
artifacts.coefficients.tsv: Exactly four model/term rows: coefficient, model-based standard error, Wald z/p, odds ratio
artifacts.model_fit.tsv: Exactly two model rows: common cohort size/events, two parameters, maximized log likelihood, AIC and convergence
artifacts.predictions.tsv: Exactly six model/profile rows: named raw-unit covariate value and fitted event probability
artifacts.answer.json: One study row: all patients, complete cases, no-pain responses, age-only and BMI-only AICs, age-only per-year slope and BMI-only per-unit slope

comparison_policy: The two models are nonnested; report their AICs but do not use a likelihood-ratio test between them

validation.independent_check: statsmodels native fit must agree with separately implemented Newton score/information solution and direct Bernoulli log likelihood

benchmark_relation.bix_51_q2: BMI as sole predictor of camrelizumab efficacy PR; this task reproduces only the single-predictor logit/AIC method on a different observed endpoint
benchmark_relation.bix_51_q8: Simple age coefficient for camrelizumab response; this task reproduces only the single-predictor per-year log-odds method on a different observed endpoint
